title: Zesty Juicy Turkish Beef Stew
description: A citrusy, hearty beef stew packed with fragrant tomatoes, aromatic spices, and bright citrus zest, perfect for a brunch‑savvy Turkish-style meal.
instructions: Cut the flank steak into 2.5 cm cubes and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Sear the beef cubes in batches, cooking until all sides are browned; remove and set aside.
Add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil, then sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, cooking for 1 minute to deepen the flavor.
Pour in the beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Return the browned beef to the pot, then add lemon juice, citrus zest, paprika, and cumin.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, cover, and lower the heat to maintain a low simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
When the beef is tender and the stew has thickened, taste and adjust seasoning if needed; serve hot over rice, bulgur, or fresh flatbread.
